ArthasMenethil expresses a positive outlook on the outcome of the garden project and the support for local vendors. He describes the future garden as a place where both the garden and local businesses will flourish, suggesting that these efforts will lead to a stronger, more vibrant community. Arthas Menethil conveys excitement and anticipation, emphasizing the idea that coming together to work on these initiatives is creating a "true community treasure." He stresses the importance of collaboration and refining plans to ensure the garden becomes an exemplary community space where the spirit of unity and shared effort translates into tangible benefits for both the garden and the local vendors. Arthas Menethil's perspective is one of optimism and celebration for the collective achievements, suggesting that the joint efforts will result in a beautiful and thriving environment that reflects the success and unity of their community.
